description: A 24-item Spanish-validated university-student questionnaire developed by Sander Paul and colleagues to measure confidence in anticipated study-related behaviours across grades, studying, attendance, and course discussion.
title: Academic Behavioural Confidence (ABC) Scale, Spanish-validated version

description: The AEQ is a self-report assessment developed by Reinhard Pekrun and colleagues to measure nine academic emotions across class-related, learning-related, and test-related situations.
title: Academic Emotions Questionnaire (AEQ)

description: A framework developed by Hamish Coates and colleagues that measures and reports institutional academic-assessment integrity across eight dimensions using 130 indicators.
title: Academic integrity indicator framework: 130 items organised under eight dimensions of academic integrity

description: A 20-week classroom-based academic-vocabulary curriculum developed by Lesaux and colleagues for linguistically diverse sixth-grade students in mainstream ELA classrooms.
title: Academic Language Instruction for All Students (ALIAS)

description: Academic Parent-Teacher Teams (APTT) is a structured family-engagement programme, developed for implementation by schools and districts, in which teachers convene parents, share assessment data, and support learning activities at home.
title: Academic Parent-Teacher Teams (APTT)

description: A 100-item English-language achievement test for senior secondary students, developed by Abe et al.
title: Academic Performance Tests in English Language (ATEL)

description: A researcher-developed 42-item algebraic-expressions achievement test created by Goksu et al.
title: Academic Success Test (AST) aligned to RBT cognitive process levels

description: A two-item self-report screening scale developed by Cassidy (2026) for first-year university students to estimate perceived course demands relative to coping resources and flag possible progression risk.
title: Academic Threat Appraisal Ratio Scale (ATARS)

description: AcademiClaw is an 80-task bilingual benchmark dataset with rubrics and evaluation code for assessing OpenClaw AI agents on complex academic workflows, created by its article authors.
title: AcademiClaw

description: These are statewide intensive-tutoring programmes run by Louisiana, Tennessee, and Texas education agencies, respectively, with dedicated public funding, approved or supported providers, tutor training, instructional materials, and implementation assistance.
title: Accelerate, TN ALL Corps, and Vetted Texas Tutor Corps

description: Accelerated Reader™ is Renaissance's software-based K–12 reading practice and assessment system in which students read books, complete computerized quizzes, and receive progress data for teacher monitoring and goal setting.
title: Accelerated Reader

description: A three-year City University of New York programme that combines financial, academic, cohort-based, and personal supports to help community-college students complete associate degrees.
title: Accelerated Study in Associate Programs (ASAP)

description: ACCESS is a two-semester cognitive-behavioral treatment and mentoring programme developed by Laura D.
title: ACCESS (Accessing Campus Connections and Empowering Student Success)

description: A Chilean National Council for Culture and the Arts, Ministry of Education, and Balmaceda Youth Art Foundation programme in which professional artists lead semester-long weekly arts workshops in public high schools, alongside schoolteachers.
title: Acciona Program (AP)

description: A high-fidelity virtual bronchoscopy training simulator made by Immersion Medical, combining a flexible-scope interface, motion and resistance hardware, simulation software, and automated procedural performance metrics for healthcare trainees.
title: AccuTouch Endoscopy Simulator

description: The ACE-HE, developed by Graham et al., is a bilingual survey instrument measuring affective, behavioral, and cognitive engagement, institutional support, and personal-environment barriers among online and blended higher-education students.
title: ACE in Higher Education (ACE-HE)

description: A California statewide initiative led by the California Surgeon General and the Department of Health Care Services that promotes adverse childhood experiences screening, provider training, and trauma-informed systems of care.
title: ACEs Aware Initiative

description: ACGME Milestones are specialty-specific performance standards used by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education to assess residents' and fellows' progression toward clinical competence and autonomy.
title: ACGME Milestones

description: A standardized ACGME and American Board of Otolaryngology milestone assessment framework that faculty use to rate otolaryngology residents' development across clinical, knowledge, communication, professionalism, and systems-based competencies.
title: ACGME otolaryngology milestone evaluation framework

description: Achieve3000® is a supplemental online literacy platform developed and provided by Achieve3000 that delivers differentiated nonfiction reading and writing instruction for learners from preK through grade 12.
title: Achieve3000

description: A 30-item author-developed achievement test for measuring eighth-grade students’ knowledge of cell division and inheritance, refined through pilot item analysis.
title: Achievement test for the unit of cell division and inheritance

description: A 30-item multiple-choice chemistry achievement test on the mole concept, drafted from validated WASSCE questions and used with SS1 students in the Lamidi et al.
title: Achievement Test on Mole Concept (ATMC)

description: A 30-item standardized Social Studies achievement test drawn from Nigeria's Universal Basic Education curriculum and administered to junior secondary school students by the study researchers.
title: Achievement test on social studies (ATSS)

description: A 40-item multiple-choice Turkish grammar achievement test developed and validated by Akif Arslan to assess eighth-grade students' spelling and punctuation knowledge before and after instruction.
title: Achievement Test to Evaluate the Effectiveness of Jigsaw I Technique in Grammar Teaching (AST)

description: An open-access collection of 23 bite-sized, multimedia interactive learning resources for health-care education, developed by the ACoRD project for undergraduate medical, pharmacy, and biomedical science learners.
title: ACoRD reusable learning objects (RLOs)

description: A school-based arts workshop programme developed by Creative Futures for Year 2 pupils, offering weekly beginner strings, singing, or drama sessions delivered by trained freelance tutors.
title: Act, Sing, Play (ASP)

description: A proficiency-assessment and performance-alignment framework developed by the American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages (ACTFL) and the National Council of State Supervisors for Languages (NCSSFL) for describing language competence and matching tasks to proficiency levels.
title: ACTFL Performance Descriptors and NCSSFL-ACTFL Can-Do Statements

description: Boniwell's framework classifies positive psychology interventions into Activity, Calming, Thinking, Identity, Optimising, Nourishing, and Social categories for organising and comparing interventions.
title: ACTIONS framework

description: A community-maintained reference framework that catalogs and defines more than 300 active-learning strategies for education researchers and disciplinary practitioners.
title: Active-Learning Strategy Guide

description: ActivEar is a gamified, personalized mobile auditory-cognitive training application developed for cognitive and speech-in-noise training in older adults with hearing loss and delivered through the CogniFit platform.
title: ActivEar

description: ActiveMath is a web-based adaptive mathematics tutoring environment developed by Erica Melis and collaborators that provides personalized curricula, problem-solving feedback, and navigational support across mathematics topics.
title: ActiveMath

description: An Excel-based case-management and activity-reporting system developed for coaching interventions, comprising daily logs, activity logs, and case-notes logs with data-validation controls.
title: Activity Reporting System

description: Acuity Predictive was an Indiana Department of Education statewide interim assessment tool that administered recurring mathematics and ELA tests and provided rapid student- and class-level performance reports, including predicted year-end proficiency.
title: Acuity Predictive interim assessment tool
